title: the system records the offer terms at submission time

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Offer snapshot at submission time

  Background:
    Given the waitlist survey API

  Scenario: a waitlist signup records the offer terms at submission time
    Given a visitor on the beta page with the current pricing matrix displayed
    When they submit the survey
    Then the waitlist signup includes an offer snapshot
    And the offer snapshot captures the management fee, installation fee, beta expectations, and professional services terms
    And it includes a timestamp so the offer can be identified later

  Scenario: the offer snapshot is honored if prices change
    Given a waitlist signup recorded under an offer with a $20/month management fee
    When the management fee changes to $25/month after the signup
    Then the original signup still shows $20/month as its offer terms
